name: v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add drag-and-drop for papers and tags by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/55
* Add delete paper button in info popover by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/56
* Disable Cmd-R reload in production builds by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/58
* Add database indexes for performance by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/59
* Fix N+1 query in getPapers and searchLibrary by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/60
* Add quick-add collection/tag buttons and split annotation toggle by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/61
* Remove dead citation graph code by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/62
* Fix User-Agent and remove dead citation indexes by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/65
* Fix duplicate paper handling in MCP and UI save paths by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/64
* Add sort options to paper list by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/66
* Add Playwright e2e tests and CI workflow by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/67
* Show paper counts on My Library and Favorites by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/68
* Add pre-push hook to protect main branch by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/72
* Fix all biome lint and format errors by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/69
* Add website landing page with automated screenshots by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/73
* Add keyboard-first navigation with Cmd+arrow shortcuts by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/74
* Move all CI tests to Linux, reserve macOS for release packaging by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/75
* Reuse CI workflow in release pipeline by @dakl in https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/pull/76


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/compare/v0.4.3...v0.8.0

name: v0.1.2
body:
## Bug fix

- Fix renderer process CPU spin caused by `useEffect` dependency issues — store actions in dependency arrays triggered re-render cascades that grew unbounded over time
- Fix stale closure in search hook

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dakl/papershelf/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2

name: v0.1.1
body:
### Fixes
- Fix macOS Gatekeeper "damaged app" error by ad-hoc signing the app bundle

### Download
Download `PaperShelf-0.1.1-arm64.dmg` below. On first launch, right-click → Open to bypass the "unidentified developer" dialog.
